svg.title: Power draw of the whole Mac with Omarchy in OmacVM.app, UTM, VMware Fusion and Parallels, and macOS itself
svg.desc: Idle (the desktop, nothing open): OmacVM.app 6.2 W (16.1 h), UTM left out: measured again (#32), VMware Fusion 5.5 W (18.2 h), Parallels 5.7 W (17.5 h), macOS 6.1 W (16.4 h). Reading (Chrome scrolling a text page): OmacVM.app 6.8 W (14.7 h), UTM left out: measured again (#32), VMware Fusion 5.9 W (16.9 h), Parallels 7.3 W (13.7 h), macOS 6.6 W (15.2 h). YouTube 4K (Chrome, SDR; macOS decodes in hardware, the VMs on the CPU): OmacVM.app 21.3 W (4.7 h), UTM 39.2 W (2.6 h), VMware Fusion 20.4 W (4.9 h), Parallels 24.2 W (4.1 h), macOS 8.0 W (12.5 h). Every core busy (all CPU cores at 100 %): OmacVM.app 71.0 W (1.4 h), UTM 61.3 W (1.6 h), VMware Fusion 73.9 W (1.4 h), Parallels 72.2 W (1.4 h), macOS 75.3 W (1.3 h). WebGL Aquarium (30,000 fish in Chrome; each draws its own frame rate): OmacVM.app 27.2 W (3.7 h), UTM 29.1 W (3.4 h), VMware Fusion 37.3 W (2.7 h), Parallels 27.4 W (3.6 h), macOS 35.6 W (2.8 h). MacBook Pro M4 Max, 100 Wh, Idle: OmacVM.app 3.0.1 5.85 W (17.1 h), macOS 6.80 W (14.7 h). MacBook Pro M4 Max, 100 Wh, Reading: OmacVM.app 3.0.1 8.27 W (12.1 h), macOS 7.71 W (13.0 h). MacBook Air M2 8 GB, 52.6 Wh, Idle: OmacVM.app 3.0.1 5.37 W (9.8 h), macOS 4.54 W (11.6 h). MacBook Air M2 8 GB, 52.6 Wh, Reading: OmacVM.app 3.0.1 5.61 W (9.4 h), macOS not run (compared with macOS idle). Watts, lower is better; hours on a full battery.
svg.text: How much power does the Mac draw?
MacBook Pro 16" M4 Max · macOS 15.7 · Google Chrome 154 · 2026-10-03
Watts, lower is better · hours on a full 100 Wh battery
hardware, the VMs on the CPU
Median of 3, macOS measured in the same hour. One scale for these rows.
– macOS: not run (compared with macOS idle)
The whole Mac, display included, from the battery's own telemetry; brightness 50 %; each VM alone in full screen.
Top: one 3-minute run per load, OmacVM.app a preview build; each load has its own scale. Hours: battery capacity over the draw.
UTM idle and reading left out: the run gave 15.2 and 19.3 W, a later check about 5 W (#32).
